usage.card.helpBody: All six values use the selected time window. Requests are locally recorded requests. Failures count HTTP status codes of 400 or higher; unknown status is not a failure. Failure rate is failures divided by requests and is unavailable when there are no requests. P95 uses measured latency samples only; a measured 0 ms is valid, while no samples and unknown sampling state remain distinct. Tokens are input plus output. Cost is estimated with the local pricing table; missing prices remain unknown. These values are local observations, not a provider bill.
usage.requests.monitorScopeHelpBody: Grouped by upstream model; real upstream failures, such as 404 responses, are included. Same-name requests rejected locally are excluded; network failures whose send stage cannot be determined follow the existing scope. Results cover only requests recorded on this device.
settings.credentials.title: Credential management
settings.credentials.help: Secrets are stored in the local managed credential store; only masks appear here. Rotation supplies the new value to future requests. Revocation rejects subsequent requests.

usage.models.tokenSpeedNote: Speed uses full end-to-end duration from request dispatch until the complete response returns, including time to first token. Only HTTP 2xx requests with a measured duration greater than 0 are included. Average is the total output tokens from successful responses divided by their total duration; maximum is the highest output Token/s from a single successful request. Display — when there are no valid successful requests.

usage.rules.title: Pricing rules
usage.rules.note: Descending priority, first hit wins; windows are local-time half-open [start, end). Save replaces the whole table; existing ledger rows are never rewritten.

usage.rules.readBackMismatch: Read-back after save did not match; refresh and check.

usage.rules.confirm.title: Save {{count}} rule changes
usage.rules.confirm.body: The rules table is replaced wholesale; new requests use the new rules, existing ledger rows are not rewritten.
usage.rules.confirm.reversibility: Revertible; changes live only in the local rules table.
usage.rules.windowHint: Start/end are minutes of the day (0..1440, [start, end); 0 0 = all day).
usage.billing.title: Billing ledger
usage.billing.note: Ledger amounts are write-time snapshots (rule-applied actuals); price changes never rewrite history.
usage.billing.dualNote: Panel stats are query-time base-price estimates; the ledger is the rule-applied actual (authoritative).

usage.billing.empty: No ledger entries in this window.
usage.billing.statementHint: Select a user to show their statement (bucketed by currency, no FX).

users.empty: No user traffic in this window.

users.rateLimit.note: Natural-minute window (local authority); RPM counts rejected attempts, TPM is a sniffed approximation. 0 or empty = unlimited.

users.armQuota.note: Per-arm (session) quota is yzagmgr-local authority; full overwrite, 0 or empty = unlimited.
